scope: MAIN multi-source reference-sequence development cohort; no independent validation
chemical_similarity: Tanimoto over concatenated substrate/product bits; multiplicity remains in identity but is not encoded by bits
homology_self_context: allowed only when the exact query protein has retained training labels, as in chemical-cold tasks; never import its held-out labels
homology_top1: highest qualifying bit score among retained training proteins; ties ascending sequence SHA256
homology_weighted: sum qualifying bit scores over training proteins carrying each label
homology_transport: normalize qualifying bit weights per query and label mass per training protein, then transport through chemistry similarity
balanced_chemical_prior: equal mass per labelled training protein, uniform over that protein's retained labels, then chemistry transport
candidate_scope: all 1341 supplied retrospective MAIN identities, frozen by dataset_02 checksum; no prospective candidate-generation claim
candidate_ties: ascending SHA256 of MAIN identity, shared across methods
unavailable_expert_domain: explicit false mask, never a zero score contribution
primary_metric: first-target-positive reciprocal rank, query-panel averages collapsed within query then equal weight to protein groups
uniform: analytic random-ranking expectation for the actual candidate and positive counts, not a fixed tie order
query_target_subsets: protein-cold all/seen/unseen labels; other tasks use held chemical-fold labels. Other known positives are not assayed negatives.
scoring_fits_on: outer train-edge indices only; no inner selection in the baseline stage
uncertainty: not produced by this baseline execution; later group and two-axis dependence-aware inference on paired outputs
pretrained_expert_additions: BLAST, ESM/CLEAN, Foldseek and local-site experts remain required separate additions, not omitted because this baseline runs
